name: Create a contact
description: Use when you need to add a new person to the Brevo contact base, optionally placing them in lists. The UI path fails on a duplicate email; the public API can update instead with update_enabled.
preconditions: Target lists, if any, must already exist.

attributes.description: Contact attributes by internal name, e.g. FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page; behavior from outside a browser was not tested.

alternative_executions.auth: API key sent in the api-key header. Not included here.

ui_steps: Fill EMAIL (required) and any attribute fields.

side_effects: Creates a contact; counts toward the plan contact limit.
Before submitting, the UI calls GET contacts-api.brevo.com/contact/backend/contacts/is_duplicate_contact, which returns {is_exist, contactId}.

verification.evidence: Created two test contacts through the UI with request capture; response {"contact_id":2}.
verification.notes: Executed through the UI (response {"contact_id":2}); error cases reproduced by replaying the call from the logged-in page on 2026-11-02, which also confirms writes work with the session cookie. listIds was sent empty in every test. The public API variant is documented only.

errors.when: The email already belongs to a contact
errors.agent_should: Do not retry. Call contacts.check_duplicate_contact with the email to get contactId, then use it (for example contacts.add_contact_to_list). Changing the existing contact's attributes needs contacts.update_contact, which is public API only: ask the user.
Fix the email and retry once; ask the user if the correct value is unknown.

errors.response: The browser reports 'Failed to fetch'; no HTTP error body reaches the client.
errors.agent_should: Treat as a validation error (email is required), not as a transient outage. Do not retry blindly.
